memories.author: D01
memories.text:
S: k/c/o T2DM and HTN, on the same tablets for some years. C/o nil hypoglycaemia. Walks in the evenings. Wife manages his tablets at home.
O: BP 138/86 mmHg, pulse 72/min, wt 75 kg. O/E: NAD. Feet: sensation normal, pedal pulses palpable.
A: 1. T2DM, stable. 2. HTN, BP above target.
P: 1. Continue metformin (Glycomet) 1000 mg BD with meals. 2. Continue amlodipine (Amlong) 5 mg OD. 3. Continue atorvastatin (Atorva) 10 mg OD. 4. Home BP readings twice a week.
Adv: Reduce pickles, papad and sugar in coffee; walk 30 min daily; cut back on salt. R/V in 3 months.
